senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. שגג) [to be excited,] to roar, shout.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 3a:6">Ber. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>על כל … ושׁוֹאֵג כארי</he> at the beginning of every watch the Lord sits and roars (in mourning) like a lion.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93:7">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>ושָׁאֲגוּ שניהם</he> and both of them shouted; a. fr.
